title: Everyone disclosed their AI use. The argument is over what counts as AI.
title_zh: 每一支隊伍都揭露了 AI 使用。真正的爭點是：什麼才算 AI。
lede: We read the official attributions record of all 106 decorated teams. The expected finding was 'almost nobody'. The actual finding is 106 of 106 — because iGEM 2026 made AI Tool Use a required block of a Bronze medal deliverable. What stays invisible is the half nobody was asked about.
lede_zh: 我們讀完全部 106 支獲獎隊伍的官方貢獻紀錄。原本預期的答案是「幾乎沒有人」，實際答案卻是 106 比 106——因為 iGEM 2026 把「AI 工具使用」列為銅牌必繳項目中的一個必填區塊。真正看不見的，是沒有人被要求交代的那一半。
body:
We went looking for a hole and found a floor. **iGEM 2026's Attributions Form carries a first-class *AI Tool Use* block**, listed by iGEM itself alongside Team Member Contributions, iGEM & Partner Offers, External Contributions and Project Timeline — and the Attributions Form is a Bronze medal criterion that, in iGEM's words, "must be filled out completely, accurately, and honestly". We opened the canonical record for every one of the 106 decorated teams in this report at `teams.igem.org/wiki/<id>/attributions`. **106 of 106 have a non-empty AI Tool Use section, and 106 of 106 name at least one general-purpose assistant.** ChatGPT appears in 80 records, Claude in 68, Gemini in 30, Doubao or Kimi in 21, DeepSeek in 18, Copilot in 6. The median section is about 1,230 characters; the shortest is 99, the longest 7,418.

This is not confined to tidying prose. Counting the task tags teams selected: **Writing 80, Wiki Coding 78, Visualization 78, Background Research 64, Analysis 60, Software 59, Conceptualization 40**. Fifty-nine of 106 decorated teams state that an assistant touched their code, and 60 that one touched their analysis. A reader who assumed the dry lab was hand-written is reading 2026 wrong.

**Then the gap.** Three different things get filed under one word. (a) Scientific machine learning a team built or trained itself. (b) Third-party foundation models used as instruments — AlphaFold, ESM, ProteinMPNN, RFdiffusion, Boltz. (c) General-purpose assistants writing code and prose. Category (c) is disclosed universally, because a form field asked for it. Category (b) mostly is not: **40 of the 106 team files name a third-party structure-prediction or protein-design model** — the technique census on this site counts AlphaFold in 32 files, ProteinMPNN in 14, and RFdiffusion, ESM and Boltz in 8 each — but **only 19 of 106 name any such model inside the AI Tool Use block, and of the 40 teams that used one, only 15 listed it there.** Category (a), a team's own trained model, almost never appears in the AI field at all; it lives on the Model page as science. That is not dishonesty, it is a genuine conceptual disagreement: teams treat running AlphaFold as structural biology, not as using an AI tool. The consequence for a reader is still real — **the attributions record reliably tells you who helped write the wiki, and not what produced the structure you are looking at.**

**Quality varies far more than presence.** Seventy-two of 106 records include review, verification or human-oversight language. Only **4 of 106** state a negative boundary — what the AI did *not* do: UOregon, GEMS-Taiwan, Uni-Padua-IT and Athens. The best disclosure of the season is not on the form at all. **Al-Nahrain-IRAQ** wrote a *Responsible AI use* section on their own attributions page: a table of use, tools and **who reviewed the result**, with model versions named, an honest row reading "An AI assistant (which one was not recorded)", a line that Gemini was used only for prototypes and "none of its output is published here", and a closing boundary — "No scientific claim, data figure, simulation result, quote, or citation on this wiki was generated by AI." **Toronto** comes second with a per-task list and the single best sentence in the cohort: "We used the raw outputs, not the AI summary, as the record." At the other end, ICJFLS files 99 characters ("Deepseek — Translate Chinese document and the content for Wiki to English") and **PSI Korea** attributes the analysis of its optical characterisation data, its wiki images and its promotion video to ChatGPT in 182 characters with no statement that anyone checked the result.

**Did anyone test a model's output at the bench and say so?** Yes, and the high-school example is the strongest. **NBJF** ran a full generative pipeline — RFdiffusion backbones, ProteinMPNN/LigandMPNN inverse folding, ESMFold and AlphaFold refolding checks, TemStaPro and SaProt scoring — then **expressed 85 de novo sequences, got detectable SDS-PAGE expression for 25, and published that as an application dataset rather than a success claim**. **HangzhouFourteenAP** is the honest inverse: FoldX ranked Y166Q top at −1.63 kcal/mol, the DNS activity assay put Q172P first at net OD 1.881 with Y166Q last at 0.629, **below wild type at 0.996** — the computational winner was worse than doing nothing. They normalised by BCA to rule out protein load, revised the published ranking, and demoted Y166Q to a mechanistic probe instead of deleting it. The other end exists too: **UMA Malaga** states outright that Diana's ranking order, substitution rule and pooling layout are untested in the lab and that the lab contradicted the substitution rule; **BAID-China**'s RFantibody designs received "computational screening and virtual validation" and no bench test; **ABOA** hands over a 28-part Golden Gate set that is designed but untested.

**Reported AI failures are rare and worth naming individually.** **Toronto** found that under homology-component-grouped splits their ESM-C embeddings lost to a single sequence-length column, reported that the random-split rho = 0.72 had been an artefact, and won Best Model for it; their Claude Sonnet literature-extraction pipeline is benchmarked against double-scored human curation at 95.0% precision and 87.1% recall with zero hallucinated enzymes across 32 doubly-scraped papers. **UPF-Barcelona** built iGEMforge, a Claude Code plugin of four skills, evaluated it over two cycles (28 cases, three runs per arm, an LLM judge against team-written rubrics, including deliberately planted flaws and silence cases), found no clear gain — experimental-design −0.11, scientific-evidence +0.04 — at roughly double the token cost, and **published that they therefore did not use it for project decisions**. **Jilin-China** ran a prespecified out-of-distribution test, found all 12 candidate-task combinations out of distribution, and declined to use the model scores at all. **Al-Nahrain-IRAQ** publishes Engine 1 as failed (2.4 g/L predicted at 13.25 h against 7.6 g/L measured) and states that parameters were read from papers with AI assistance and have not yet been re-checked by a team member. **XJTLU-Software** built delivery reconciliation into AMPilot on the premise that "a fluent closing message is not a delivery receipt". Five negative reports in 106 files. That is the scarce good.

**GEMS-Taiwan, assessed on the same scale.** The team's record names three tools — Claude (Anthropic), Gemini (Google), ChatGPT (OpenAI) — with task tags, and closes with one of only four negative boundaries in the cohort: "All AI outputs were verified by team members against primary literature or experimental data before use. No experimental data, results, or citations were AI-generated." That is above the median. What it does not do: the same paragraph is repeated verbatim under all three tools, so the record never says what each one actually did differently; no model versions are given and no reviewer is named for any item; **AlphaFold, which the project ran with a pre-set confidence gate, is not in the AI field at all**, so the team reproduces exactly the category-(b) blind spot described above; and the LLM-assisted QGIS workflow over 346 farming townships — the one place the team did something a reader would want the prompt for, and did publish the data-preparation prompt — is covered only by a generic *Analysis* tag that does not point at it. The team's own page at `2026.igem.wiki/gems-taiwan/attributions/` is also nothing but an embedded frame of the iGEM form: a reader whose browser blocks the frame sees a banner and no attribution at all. **Verdict for the whole cohort, GEMS included: the disclosure on display is *at* what iGEM asked for, and only rarely above it.** iGEM asked which tools and which tasks, so teams supplied tools and tasks. iGEM did not ask who reviewed each output, which model version produced it, or what the AI did not do — so almost nobody said.
body_zh:
我們本來要找一個破洞，結果找到一塊地板。**iGEM 2026 的 Attributions Form 內建了一個正式的 *AI Tool Use*（AI 工具使用）區塊**，由 iGEM 自己與「團隊成員貢獻」「iGEM 與夥伴提供的資源」「外部貢獻」「專案時間軸」並列；而 Attributions Form 本身是銅牌評分條件，依 iGEM 的用字，它「必須完整、準確、誠實地填寫」。我們在 `teams.igem.org/wiki/<id>/attributions` 打開本報告 106 支獲獎隊伍的官方紀錄。**106 支裡有 106 支的 AI Tool Use 區塊不是空的，而且 106 支全部至少列出一個通用型 AI 助理。** ChatGPT 出現在 80 份紀錄中，Claude 68 份，Gemini 30 份，Doubao 或 Kimi 21 份，DeepSeek 18 份，Copilot 6 份。區塊長度中位數約 1,230 字元，最短 99，最長 7,418。

這也不只是潤稿而已。依隊伍自己勾選的任務標籤計算：**Writing 80、Wiki Coding 78、Visualization 78、Background Research 64、Analysis 60、Software 59、Conceptualization 40**。106 支獲獎隊伍中，有 59 支明說 AI 助理碰過他們的程式碼，60 支說碰過他們的分析。若有人以為 2026 年的乾實驗室是純手工，那是讀錯了這一季。

**接著是那個缺口。** 三件完全不同的事被塞進同一個詞裡。(a) 團隊自己建立或訓練的科學機器學習模型。(b) 當成儀器使用的第三方基礎模型——AlphaFold、ESM、ProteinMPNN、RFdiffusion、Boltz。(c) 用來寫程式與寫文字的通用型助理。第 (c) 類被普遍揭露，因為有一個欄位在問它。第 (b) 類大多沒有：**106 份團隊檔案中有 40 份提到第三方結構預測或蛋白質設計模型**——本站的技術普查頁計得 AlphaFold 出現在 32 份、ProteinMPNN 14 份、RFdiffusion／ESM／Boltz 各 8 份——但**只有 19 支在 AI Tool Use 區塊裡提到任何一個這類模型；在那 40 支實際用過的隊伍中，只有 15 支把它寫進該欄位。** 第 (a) 類，也就是隊伍自己訓練的模型，幾乎從不出現在 AI 欄位裡；它被放在 Model 頁上，當成科學。這不是不誠實，而是一個真實的概念分歧：隊伍把跑 AlphaFold 視為結構生物學，而不是使用 AI 工具。但對讀者而言，後果是實在的——**這份貢獻紀錄能可靠告訴你誰幫忙寫了 wiki，卻不告訴你眼前這個結構是誰算出來的。**

**品質的落差遠大於有無。** 106 份紀錄中有 72 份含有審查、查核或人工監督的字句。只有 **4 份**寫出了否定邊界，也就是 AI *沒有*做什麼：UOregon、GEMS-Taiwan、Uni-Padua-IT 與 Athens。而本季最好的一份揭露根本不在表單上。**Al-Nahrain-IRAQ** 在自家貢獻頁上寫了一節 *Responsible AI use*：一張列出用途、工具與**由誰審查**的表格，標明模型版本，還有一列誠實寫著「An AI assistant (which one was not recorded)」（某個 AI 助理，但沒記錄是哪一個），另註明 Gemini 只用於原型，「none of its output is published here」（它的輸出沒有任何一項發表在這裡），最後收在一句邊界：「No scientific claim, data figure, simulation result, quote, or citation on this wiki was generated by AI.」（本 wiki 上沒有任何科學主張、資料圖、模擬結果、引語或參考文獻是 AI 生成的。）**Toronto** 居次，逐項任務條列，並寫下全體隊伍中最好的一句：「We used the raw outputs, not the AI summary, as the record.」（我們以原始輸出而非 AI 摘要作為紀錄。）另一端，ICJFLS 只交了 99 個字元（「Deepseek——把中文文件與 wiki 內容翻成英文」）；**PSI Korea** 用 182 個字元，把光學特性資料的分析、wiki 圖像與宣傳影片都歸給 ChatGPT，卻沒有任何一句說有人查核過結果。

**有沒有人把模型輸出拿去實驗台驗證，而且講清楚？** 有，而且最強的例子來自高中組。**NBJF** 跑完一整條生成式設計流程——RFdiffusion 產生骨架、ProteinMPNN／LigandMPNN 反向折疊、ESMFold 與 AlphaFold 重折疊檢查、TemStaPro 與 SaProt 評分——接著**表現了 85 條 de novo 序列，其中 25 條在 SDS-PAGE 上可偵測到表現，並且把這份結果當成應用資料集發表，而不是當成成功宣告**。**HangzhouFourteenAP** 則是誠實的反例：FoldX 把 Y166Q 排第一（−1.63 kcal/mol），DNS 活性測定卻把 Q172P 排第一（淨 OD 1.881），Y166Q 墊底只有 0.629，**低於野生型的 0.996**——運算上的贏家比什麼都不改還差。他們以 BCA 定量標準化以排除蛋白質載量的影響，在正文中修正了已發表的排序，並把 Y166Q 降格為機制探針，而不是悄悄刪掉。另一端也存在：**UMA Malaga** 直接寫明 Diana 的排序規則、置換規則與混池佈局都未經實驗驗證，而且實驗結果與置換規則相牴觸；**BAID-China** 的 RFantibody 設計只做了「運算篩選與虛擬驗證」，沒有實驗台測試；**ABOA** 交出一組設計完成但未經測試的 28 個 Golden Gate 零件。

**被報告出來的 AI 失敗很少，值得一個一個點名。** **Toronto** 發現在以同源性連通分量分組切分資料後，他們的 ESM-C 嵌入向量輸給了「序列長度」這單一欄位，並報告隨機切分下的 rho = 0.72 其實是假象，也因此拿下最佳模型獎；他們以 Claude Sonnet 建立的文獻萃取流程，對照雙人重複標註的人工語料做了基準測試，精確率 95.0%、召回率 87.1%，在 32 篇雙重萃取的論文中沒有任何一個幻覺出來的酵素。**UPF-Barcelona** 做了 iGEMforge，一個含四項技能的 Claude Code 外掛，經過兩輪評估（28 個案例、每組三次執行、以 LLM 擔任評審對照隊伍自撰的評分準則，含刻意植入瑕疵的案例與「應該保持沉默」的案例），結果沒有明顯增益——experimental-design −0.11、scientific-evidence +0.04——而 token 成本約為兩倍，於是**公開說明他們因此沒有用它來做專案決策**。**Jilin-China** 先跑了預先設定的分布外（OOD）檢查，發現 12 組候選—任務組合全部落在分布外，就乾脆完全不採用模型分數。**Al-Nahrain-IRAQ** 把 Engine 1 當成失敗發表（13.25 小時預測 2.4 g/L，實測 7.6 g/L），並說明參數是在 AI 協助下從論文讀出來的，尚未由任何一位隊員重新核對。**XJTLU-Software** 在 AMPilot 中加入交付核對機制，前提是「一則流暢的結語訊息不等於一張交付收據」。106 份檔案裡五份負面報告。那就是稀缺的好東西。

**用同一把尺看 GEMS-Taiwan。** 該隊的紀錄列出三個工具——Claude (Anthropic)、Gemini (Google)、ChatGPT (OpenAI)——附任務標籤，並以全體僅有的四個否定邊界之一作結：「All AI outputs were verified by team members against primary literature or experimental data before use. No experimental data, results, or citations were AI-generated.」（所有 AI 輸出在使用前都經隊員對照原始文獻或實驗資料查核。沒有任何實驗資料、結果或引用是 AI 生成的。）這高於中位數。但它沒有做到的是：同一段文字在三個工具底下逐字重複，所以這份紀錄從未說出每個工具各自實際做了什麼不同的事；沒有標明模型版本，也沒有為任何一項指名審查者；**專案以預設信心門檻跑過的 AlphaFold，根本不在 AI 欄位裡**，因此該隊正好複製了上文描述的第 (b) 類盲點；而那套涵蓋 346 個農業鄉鎮、由 LLM 協助的 QGIS 工作流——全隊最值得讀者看到提示詞的一處，而且團隊確實公開了資料準備用的提示詞——在紀錄裡只被一個籠統的 *Analysis* 標籤涵蓋，沒有任何指向。該隊自家的 `2026.igem.wiki/gems-taiwan/attributions/` 頁面也只是一個嵌入 iGEM 表單的內嵌框架：瀏覽器若擋下該框架，讀者看到的就是一張橫幅與完全沒有貢獻紀錄。**對整個群體（包含 GEMS）的結論是：眼前的揭露水準*正好等於* iGEM 要求的水準，很少高過它。** iGEM 問的是用了哪些工具、做了哪些任務，隊伍就交出工具與任務。iGEM 沒有問每一項輸出由誰審查、是哪個模型版本產出的、以及 AI 沒有做什麼——所以幾乎沒有人說。

cards.title: 106 of 106 — because a form field asked
cards.title_zh: 106 比 106——因為有一個欄位在問
cards.body: Every decorated team in this report has a non-empty AI Tool Use section in its official iGEM attributions record, and every one names at least one general-purpose assistant. The median entry runs about 1,230 characters. This is the one place in iGEM where a disclosure norm already exists and is universally obeyed — and the reason is simply that the deliverable has a box for it.
cards.body_zh: 本報告中每一支獲獎隊伍，在其官方 iGEM 貢獻紀錄裡的 AI Tool Use 區塊都不是空的，而且每一支都至少列出一個通用型 AI 助理。項目長度中位數約 1,230 字元。這是 iGEM 中唯一一個揭露規範已經存在且被普遍遵守的地方——原因很單純：那份必繳文件上有一個欄位。

cards.title: AI Tool Use is part of a Bronze medal criterion
cards.title_zh: AI 工具使用，屬於銅牌評分條件的一部分
cards.body: iGEM's own deliverables guide lists five submission blocks for the required Attributions Form: Team Member Contributions, AI Tool Use, iGEM & Partner Offers, External Contributions, Project Timeline. The medals page makes the Attributions Form Bronze criterion 2 and says it "must be filled out completely, accurately, and honestly". So AI disclosure in 2026 was not optional and not a special-prize flourish — it was the price of a bronze medal.
cards.body_zh: iGEM 自己的繳交項目指引列出必繳 Attributions Form 的五個區塊：團隊成員貢獻、AI 工具使用、iGEM 與夥伴資源、外部貢獻、專案時間軸。獎牌頁把 Attributions Form 列為銅牌第 2 項條件，並寫明它「必須完整、準確、誠實地填寫」。所以 2026 年的 AI 揭露既不是選填，也不是為了特別獎的裝飾——它是拿到銅牌的入場費。

cards.title: AlphaFold is filed as biology, not as AI
cards.title_zh: AlphaFold 被歸檔為生物學，而不是 AI
cards.body: Forty of the 106 team files name a third-party structure-prediction or protein-design model. Only 19 teams name any such model inside the AI Tool Use block, and only 15 of the 40 actual users put it there. Teams read "AI tool" as "chatbot", so the record tells you who drafted the wiki text and not what produced the structure in the figure. A disclosure norm that only catches assistants catches the cheaper half.
cards.body_zh: 106 份團隊檔案中有 40 份提到第三方結構預測或蛋白質設計模型。只有 19 支在 AI Tool Use 區塊裡提到任何一個這類模型，而在那 40 支實際使用者中，只有 15 支寫在那裡。隊伍把「AI 工具」讀成「聊天機器人」，於是紀錄告訴你 wiki 文字是誰起草的，卻不告訴你圖上的結構是誰算出來的。一套只抓得到助理的揭露規範，抓到的是比較便宜的那一半。

cards.title: Al-Nahrain-IRAQ wrote the table everyone else should copy
cards.title_zh: Al-Nahrain-IRAQ 寫出了其他人都該照抄的那張表
cards.body: Their wiki carries a Responsible AI use section beyond the form: a table of use, tools and who reviewed the result; model versions named; a row that honestly reads "An AI assistant (which one was not recorded)"; a note that Gemini was used only for prototypes and "none of its output is published here"; and the boundary "No scientific claim, data figure, simulation result, quote, or citation on this wiki was generated by AI." They also publish their own failed model engine on the same wiki.
cards.body_zh: 他們的 wiki 在表單之外另寫了一節 Responsible AI use：一張列出用途、工具與由誰審查的表格；標明模型版本；其中一列誠實寫著「某個 AI 助理（沒記錄是哪一個）」；另註明 Gemini 只用於原型，「它的輸出沒有任何一項發表在這裡」；最後收在一句邊界：「本 wiki 上沒有任何科學主張、資料圖、模擬結果、引語或參考文獻是 AI 生成的。」同一個 wiki 上，他們也公開了自己失敗的模型引擎。

cards.title: 85 designs expressed, 25 detectable, published as a dataset
cards.title_zh: 表現了 85 條設計、25 條可偵測，當成資料集發表
cards.body: NBJF, a high-school team, ran RFdiffusion, ProteinMPNN/LigandMPNN, ESMFold, AlphaFold, TemStaPro and SaProt, then took 85 de novo sequences to the bench, got detectable SDS-PAGE expression for 25, and reported the result as an application dataset rather than a success claim. Compare UMA Malaga, which says plainly that its ranking order, substitution rule and pooling layout are untested in the lab — and that the lab contradicted the substitution rule.
cards.body_zh: 高中隊伍 NBJF 跑了 RFdiffusion、ProteinMPNN／LigandMPNN、ESMFold、AlphaFold、TemStaPro 與 SaProt，接著把 85 條 de novo 序列帶進實驗台，其中 25 條在 SDS-PAGE 上可偵測到表現，並把結果當成應用資料集而非成功宣告發表。對照 UMA Malaga：它直說自己的排序規則、置換規則與混池佈局都未經實驗驗證——而且實驗結果與置換規則相牴觸。

cards.title: The prediction that lost, and the plugin that did not help
cards.title_zh: 輸掉的那個預測，和沒幫上忙的那個外掛
cards.body: HangzhouFourteenAP: FoldX picked Y166Q at -1.63 kcal/mol; the assay put it last at net OD 0.629, below wild type at 0.996, and they revised the published ranking. UPF-Barcelona built a Claude Code plugin, A/B tested it over 28 cases with planted flaws, found no clear gain at double the token cost, and said so. Toronto reported that a homology-grouped split made their embeddings lose to sequence length. Jilin-China ran an out-of-distribution check and declined to use the scores. Al-Nahrain-IRAQ published a failed engine.
cards.body_zh: HangzhouFourteenAP：FoldX 以 −1.63 kcal/mol 選出 Y166Q，活性測定卻把它排到最後（淨 OD 0.629），低於野生型的 0.996，於是他們修正了已發表的排序。UPF-Barcelona 做了一個 Claude Code 外掛，用 28 個含植入瑕疵的案例做 A/B 測試，發現在兩倍 token 成本下沒有明顯增益，並且照實說出來。Toronto 報告以同源性分組切分後，他們的嵌入向量輸給了序列長度。Jilin-China 跑了分布外檢查後決定不採用分數。Al-Nahrain-IRAQ 公開了一個失敗的引擎。

cards.title: GEMS-Taiwan is above the median and below its own standard
cards.title_zh: GEMS-Taiwan 高於中位數，低於自己的標準
cards.body: The team's record names Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT with task tags and one of only four negative boundaries in the cohort. But the same paragraph repeats verbatim under all three tools, no model versions or per-item reviewers are given, the project's AlphaFold work is absent from the AI field entirely, and the published LLM-assisted QGIS prompt is not pointed at. The attributions page itself is an embedded frame of the iGEM form, so a reader whose browser blocks it sees no attribution at all.
cards.body_zh: 該隊的紀錄列出 Claude、Gemini 與 ChatGPT，附任務標籤，並寫下全體僅有的四個否定邊界之一。但同一段文字在三個工具底下逐字重複，沒有模型版本、也沒有逐項審查者；專案中的 AlphaFold 工作完全沒有出現在 AI 欄位；已公開的 LLM 協助 QGIS 提示詞也沒有被指向。貢獻頁本身只是嵌入 iGEM 表單的內嵌框架，瀏覽器若擋下它，讀者看到的是完全沒有貢獻紀錄。

checklist: Record it the day it happens, not in October. One line in the dry-lab notebook per session: date, tool and version (Claude Opus 5.1, not "AI"), what you asked for, what you kept, and who checked it. The 2026 teams with the best records are the ones who logged as they went; the one who wrote "an AI assistant (which one was not recorded)" is the honest cost of logging late.

Disclose all three kinds, not just the chatbot. (a) A model you trained or fitted yourself goes on the Model page with its data split. (b) A third-party model you ran as an instrument - AlphaFold, ESM, ProteinMPNN, Boltz - goes in the methods AND in the AI record, with version and settings, because 2026 shows 25 of 40 teams left it out of the AI record entirely. (c) A general-purpose assistant goes in the AI record with the task it touched.

A tool is a tool; nothing is a co-author. Name the tool, name the human who is answerable for the output. Every GEMS artefact - a figure, a script, a paragraph, a parameter - has exactly one named human reviewer, and that name goes next to the tool, as Al-Nahrain-IRAQ did.

Mark every model output UNVALIDATED until a bench result exists, in the text and in the figure caption. A predicted structure, a designed sequence, a ranked shortlist, a fitted parameter read out of a paper: all unvalidated until measured. Write the status, not the hope - UMA Malaga's three honest categories (automated tests / real services / wet lab, with "not shown" recorded as a result) are the model to copy.

Publish the prompt or the script whenever the AI produced data rather than prose. If an assistant extracted parameters, prepared a GIS layer or read numbers out of figures, the prompt is part of the method and belongs in the repository with the code.

Write the negative boundary explicitly: what AI did not do. Only 4 of 106 decorated teams did this in 2026. One sentence - no experimental data, no result, no citation, no scientific claim was AI-generated - is cheap to write and is the single line a sceptical reader is looking for.

Benchmark the assistant when it does scientific work, and publish the number. Toronto measured their extraction pipeline at 95.0% precision and 87.1% recall against double-scored human curation. An unbenchmarked extraction pipeline is not a method, it is a hope.

Report the failures. The AI prediction that lost to the bench, the designed sequence that did not express, the plugin that did not beat the base model, the hallucinated reference caught in review. Five teams in 106 did this in 2026 and one of them won Best Model for it. Log every caught hallucination with its citation so the count exists at the end of the season.
checklist_zh: 當天就記錄，不要等到十月。乾實驗室筆記本每次工作寫一行：日期、工具與版本（寫 Claude Opus 5.1，不要寫「AI」）、你要求了什麼、你採用了什麼、由誰查核。2026 年紀錄最好的隊伍都是邊做邊記的；那句「某個 AI 助理（沒記錄是哪一個）」，就是太晚才記錄的誠實代價。

三類都要揭露，不是只揭露聊天機器人。(a) 你自己訓練或擬合的模型，放在 Model 頁並附上資料切分方式。(b) 你當成儀器使用的第三方模型——AlphaFold、ESM、ProteinMPNN、Boltz——除了寫進方法，也要寫進 AI 紀錄，附版本與設定；因為 2026 年的資料顯示，40 支用過的隊伍中有 25 支完全沒寫進 AI 紀錄。(c) 通用型助理寫進 AI 紀錄，並註明它碰了哪一項工作。
工具就是工具，沒有任何東西是共同作者。寫出工具名稱，也寫出為該輸出負責的那個人。GEMS 的每一項產出——一張圖、一段程式、一段文字、一個參數——都只有一位具名的人類審查者，而那個名字要緊鄰工具名稱並列，就像 Al-Nahrain-IRAQ 那樣。
在有實驗結果之前，每一項模型輸出都標示為「未驗證」，正文與圖說都要標。預測出的結構、設計出的序列、排序後的候選名單、從論文讀來的擬合參數：在被量測之前一律未驗證。寫狀態，不要寫願望——UMA Malaga 那三個誠實的分類（自動化測試／真實服務／濕實驗，並把「未呈現」本身記為一種結果）值得照抄。
只要 AI 產出的是資料而不是文字，就公開提示詞或腳本。如果助理萃取了參數、準備了 GIS 圖層，或從圖裡讀出數字，那段提示詞就是方法的一部分，應該和程式碼一起放進版本庫。
明確寫出否定邊界：AI 沒有做什麼。2026 年 106 支獲獎隊伍中只有 4 支做到。一句話——沒有任何實驗資料、結果、引用或科學主張是 AI 生成的——寫起來很便宜，而且正是存疑的讀者在找的那一行。
當助理做的是科學工作時，要做基準測試並公開數字。Toronto 量出他們的萃取流程對照雙人重複標註的精確率 95.0%、召回率 87.1%。一條沒有基準測試的萃取流程不是方法，只是一廂情願。
把失敗報出來。輸給實驗台的 AI 預測、表現不出來的設計序列、贏不過基礎模型的外掛、在審查中抓到的幻覺參考文獻。2026 年 106 支隊伍中有五支這麼做，其中一支還因此拿下最佳模型獎。每抓到一次幻覺就連同該引用一起記下來，這樣一季結束時才會有一個數字。
method: Base rate: we opened the canonical iGEM attributions record for each of the 106 decorated teams in this report at teams.igem.org/wiki/<id>/attributions - the same record their wikis display - rendered it in a browser (the pages are client-side React and return an empty shell to a plain fetch), and extracted the AI Tool Use section verbatim. All 106 returned a page and all 106 had a non-empty AI Tool Use section; none was missing or truncated. Tool and task counts are regex matches on those extracted sections, so a tool named only in an attached document or on a Model page is not counted here, and 'review language' means the section contains words such as review, verify, check, validate or oversight, which is a weaker test than actually reviewing. Foundation-model use (40 of 106) is counted from the dry-lab fields of the 106 team files on this site; the per-tool figures quoted (AlphaFold 32, ProteinMPNN 14, RFdiffusion 8, ESM 8, Boltz 8) are the technique census page's numbers, not ours, and we report them so the two pages agree. The iGEM requirement is quoted from competition.igem.org/deliverables/guides and the medals page; the detailed Attributions Form requirements page is behind a team login and we did not read it. The hard limit: this method can only see what a team wrote down. Undisclosed assistant use is invisible by construction - we cannot detect it, we did not try to infer it, and nothing here should be read as a claim about which teams 'probably' used more AI than they said. Equally, a disclosure is a statement, not evidence: we checked what teams wrote, not whether it is complete. The 106/106 figure therefore measures compliance with a required form field, not the true extent of AI use, and the 4-of-106 negative-boundary figure and the 5 reported failures are the numbers that actually distinguish teams, because those were not asked for. The sample is decorated teams only, so this is not a base rate for the competition.
method_zh: 基準比率：我們針對本報告 106 支獲獎隊伍，逐一打開 teams.igem.org/wiki/<id>/attributions 上的官方 iGEM 貢獻紀錄（也就是各隊 wiki 所顯示的同一份紀錄），在瀏覽器中完成算繪（這些頁面是用戶端 React，直接抓取只會得到空殼），並逐字擷取其中的 AI Tool Use 區塊。106 份全部成功載入，106 份的 AI Tool Use 區塊都不是空的，沒有缺漏或截斷。工具與任務的計數是對這些擷取段落做樣式比對，因此只出現在附件文件或 Model 頁上的工具不會被計入；而「審查字句」僅表示該段落包含 review、verify、check、validate 或 oversight 等字詞，這是比「真的有審查」寬鬆得多的判準。基礎模型使用（106 支中 40 支）是依本站 106 份團隊檔案的乾實驗室欄位計算；文中引用的各工具數字（AlphaFold 32、ProteinMPNN 14、RFdiffusion 8、ESM 8、Boltz 8）取自本站技術普查頁，不是我們自己的計數，列出是為了讓兩頁一致。iGEM 的要求引自 competition.igem.org/deliverables/guides 與獎牌頁；Attributions Form 的詳細要求頁需要隊伍登入，我們沒有閱讀。硬性限制：這個方法只看得見團隊寫下來的東西。未揭露的助理使用在定義上就是看不見的——我們偵測不到，也沒有嘗試推論，本頁任何內容都不應被讀成在指認哪些隊伍「大概」用得比說的多。同樣地，揭露是一種陳述，不是證據：我們查核的是團隊寫了什麼，而不是寫得完不完整。因此 106 比 106 這個數字量到的是對一個必填欄位的遵循程度，而不是 AI 使用的真實範圍；真正能區分隊伍的，是「106 支中只有 4 支寫出否定邊界」與「5 份負面報告」這兩個數字，因為那兩件事沒有人要求。樣本僅限獲獎隊伍，所以這不是整個競賽的基準比率。
